description: The headless color input core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. SvColorInput is a styled renderer over createColorInput, which owns hex normalization, the palette, the draft text field and open and close state, exposed as swatchProps and chipProps. The styled version adds a portalled popover; the demo's custom render draws an inline swatch plus palette panel from the same core, both bound to one value.

faq.question: What does hex normalization do?
faq.answer: normalizeHex accepts 3 or 6 digit values with or without the hash, expands short form and stores a canonical six-digit lower-case hex, or null for invalid text, so both renders agree on the value.

faq.question: How is the palette exposed?
faq.answer: As an array the core filters and marks with the selected entry; chipProps(i) gives each swatch its button role, aria-pressed and click handler.

faq.question: Do I need the portal?
faq.answer: No. The core has no notion of a popover. The styled component portals for use inside grid cells; an inline panel is just another render.
